'''Teresa Kowalska''' (19 July 1946 – 2023) was a Polish chemist, specialized in the theory and application of [[chromatography]]. She was a professor emeritus of [[University of Silesia in Katowice]].

== Education ==
Kowalska received a master's degree in [[chemistry]] in 1968 and a PhD in [[physical chemistry]] in 1972, both from Higher Pedagogical School in Katowice, which became University of Silesia in Katowice. She conducted post-doctoral research at [[University of Salford]] in the UK, under the supervision of Hans Suschitzky. She received a [[habilitation]] degree in 1988 from [[Maria Curie-Skłodowska University]], with the habilitation [[dissertation]] titled ''A New Thermodynamic Model of the Chromatographic Process and its Applications.''<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal |date=2023-05-17 |title=In memoriam Professor Dr Teresa Kowalska (1946–2023) |url=https://akjournals.com/view/journals/1326/35/3/article-p217.xml |journal=Acta Chromatographica|volume=35 |issue=3 |pages=217–218 |doi=10.1556/1326.2023.11111 |issn=2083-5736|doi-access=free }}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |date=2016 |editor-last=Komsta |editor-first=Łukasz |title=Professor Dr. Teresa Kowalska — In honor of her birthday |url=https://akjournals.com/doi/10.1556/1006.2016.29.4.0 |journal=Journal of Planar Chromatography|volume=29 |issue=4 |pages=237–238 |doi=10.1556/1006.2016.29.4.0 |s2cid=99603583 |issn=0933-4173|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Planar Chromatography - Mass Spectrometry |url=https://www.routledge.com/Planar-Chromatography---Mass-Spectrometry/Kowalska-Sajewicz-Sherma/p/book/9780367575274 |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=Routledge & CRC Pres}}</ref>

== Career ==
Kowalska was professor emeritus at the Institute of Chemistry of University of Silesia in Katowice, where she began her career in 1968 as assistant professor, associate professor (since 1991), and full professor (since 2000). From 2004, she headed the Department of Physicochemical Foundations of Chromatography at the Institute of Chemistry, which was renamed to the Department of General Chemistry and Chromatography in 2006.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-02-13 |title=Zmarła prof. Teresa Kowalska {{!}} Uniwersytet Śląski w Katowicach |url=https://us.edu.pl/zmarla-prof-teresa-kowalska/ |access-date=2023-12-24 |language=pl}}</ref>

Over her career, the research topics of Kowalska focused on chromatography. She co-authored over 300 peer-reviewed publications on the topic<ref>{{Cite web |title=Teresa Kowalska |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=PgHOhHIAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> and co-edited five chromatography books: ''Preparative Layer Chromatography'' (2006),<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Kowalska |first1=Teresa |title=Preparative layer chromatography |last2=Sherma |first2=Joseph |date=2006 |publisher=Taylor & Francis |isbn=978-0-8493-4039-0 |series=Chromatographic science series |location=Boca Raton}}</ref> ''Thin Layer Chromatography in Chiral Separations and Analysis'' (2007),<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Kowalska |first1=Teresa |title=Thin layer chromatography in chiral separations and analysis |last2=Sherma |first2=Joseph |date=2007 |publisher=CRC Press |isbn=978-0-8493-4369-8 |series=Chromatographic science series |location=Boca Raton (Fla.)}}</ref> ''Thin Layer Chromatography in Phytochemistry'' (2008),<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Waksmundzka-Hajnos |first1=Monika |title=Thin layer chromatography in phytochemistry |last2=Kowalska |first2=Teresa |last3=Sherma |first3=Joseph |date=2008 |publisher=Taylor & Francis |isbn=978-1-4200-4677-9 |series=Chromatographic science series |location=Boca Raton}}</ref> ''Planar Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry'' (2015),<ref>{{Cite book |title=Planar Chromatography: Mass Spectrometry |date=2020 |publisher=CRC Press, Taylor & Francis Group |isbn=978-0-367-57527-4 |editor-last=Kowalska |editor-first=Teresa |edition=First issued in paperback |series=Chromatographic science series |location=Boca Raton, Fla. London New York |editor-last2=Sajewicz |editor-first2=Mieczysław |editor-last3=Sherma |editor-first3=Joseph}}</ref> ''Chromatographic Techniques in the Forensic Analysis of Designer Drugs'' (2018).<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://www.taylorfrancis.com/books/9781315313160 |title=Chromatographic Techniques in the Forensic Analysis of Designer Drugs |date=2018 |publisher=CRC Press |isbn=978-1-315-31317-7 |editor-last=Kowalska |editor-first=Teresa |edition=1 |location=Boca Raton : Taylor & Francis/CRC Press, 2018. {{!}} Series: Chromatographic science series|doi=10.1201/9781315313177 |editor-last2=Sajewicz |editor-first2=Mieczysław |editor-last3=Sherma |editor-first3=Joseph}}</ref> In 2017, the International Symposium for High-Performance Thin-Layer Chromatography called her "the First Lady of chiral TLC ([[Thin-layer chromatography|Thin Layer Chromatography]])/HPTLC (High Performance Thin Layer Chromatography)".<ref>{{Cite web |title=International Symposium for High-Performance Thin-Layer Chromatography 2017 Book of Abstract |url=https://www.hptlc.com/version-2017/Book-of-abstracts-HPTLC-2017.pdf |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=International Symposium for High-Performance Thin-Layer Chromatography}}</ref>

To address the lack of comprehensive chromatographic journals, Kowalska founded ''[[Acta Chromatographica]]'' with Józef Śliwiok in 1992. In addition to ''Acta Chromatographica'', she also served on the editorial boards of ''Journal of Planar Chromatography'' and ''Chromatography Research International''.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Acta Chromatographica |url=https://akjournals.com/view/journals/1326/1326-overview.xml |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=AKJournals}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Hindawi |title=Pharmaceutical and Herbal Fingerprinting by Means of Chromatographic Techniques |url=https://www.hindawi.com/journals/cri/si/563858/ |access-date=2023-12-24 |website=Hindawi}}</ref>
